criterion: For distinct lifted x coordinates, test (y1+y2)^2=(x1-x2)^2(2*x1+x2); classify all selected-vector candidate attempts by archived status and public-relation diagnostic.
positive_controls: Check every archived positive rational control against the criterion after clearing rational denominators.
negative_controls: Check every archived negative rational control against the criterion after clearing rational denominators.
scope: exact algebraic replay and candidate counts, not a wall-time comparison
